rust_summary: the clipboard for a mod's text fields (`native_clipboard`, `native_set_clipboard`).
doc_summary: `native_clipboard()` is the text on the clipboard (`KeyboardHandler.getClipboard`), empty when it holds none; `native_set_clipboard(text)` copies text to it (`KeyboardHandler.setClipboard`), empty text not copied. Client-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:native_clipboard@.
